mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger corporate earnings warnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.5% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 2% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During industrial production contraction (INDPRO below 95.0), a decline in manufacturing output signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and future earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above its 4-quarter moving average signals robust economic growth that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds the 4-quarter moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When core inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% annually, it signals persistent inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines by at least 0.5% and UNRATE rises by at least 0.2 percentage points from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During ultra-low interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), a further decline in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary easing that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% and declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.
